goal: Make every dynamic verify-gate.sh row name collision-free and assert uniqueness at registration, so two checks can never share a status slot and a log file.
non_goals: Changing which checks the gate runs, their order, or the parallel fan-out
Changing gate-status.json's schema or the Stop hook / arm-check contract
Fixing #694 (ci:live-db-suites R2 DDL detector) — same theme, separate ticket
Reverting the #679 call-site workaround (import-offer-analytics.integration.test.ts keeps its name)
user_visible_behavior: Integration and extra rows print as <truncated-path-prefix>-<6-char-hash> instead of a bare 40-char prefix
Two changed *.integration.test.ts files sharing a 40-character path prefix produce two distinct rows, two distinct log files, and two distinct coverage directories
A duplicate row name aborts the gate with a named error and a RED gate-status.json instead of silently overwriting a row
invariants: One row name = one status slot = one .feature/logs/<name>.log = one coverage directory
A failed check can never be reported as PASS
The gate never exits with a stale-green .feature/gate-status.json on disk
edge_cases: Two integration suites whose paths share exactly the first 40 slug characters (the live #696 example)
Two verification_commands sharing a 40-character prefix (line 167 has the same truncation as line 193)
A rejected destructive extra colliding with another rejected extra
bash 3.2 on macOS: no `wait -n`, no associative arrays, and `${NAMES[@]}` on an empty array under `set -u`
existing_patterns_to_follow: scripts/verify-gate.sh — the db-provision failure path (writes a RED gate-status.json, prints the table, exits 1) is the precedent for an abort
scripts/ci/__tests__/merge-coverage.test.ts — a test under scripts/ci/__tests__/ covering a script that lives in scripts/
src/__tests__/ci-audit-wiring.test.ts — reading a config/script file as text and asserting it cannot drift
tests_to_add: derives distinct slugs for integration suites sharing a 40-character path prefix
keeps the truncated path prefix readable in the derived slug
accepts a row name that is not already registered
exits non-zero when a row name is already registered
accepts the first row name when no rows are registered yet
routes every dynamic row name in verify-gate.sh through row_slug
registers every launched row through assert_unique_row_name
rollback_plan: Not DB-touching. Revert the single commit; no state, no flag, no migration.
observability: The gate's printed table is the signal: each integration/extra row now carries a hash suffix, and a duplicate prints `verify-gate: duplicate row name '<name>'` and exits RED
